dct_description_sm: 36 narratives from Inuit women were analysed using a thematical analysis approach to create themes and categories in order to identify the determinants of Inuit women food insecurity. Ultimatly, the determinants of food insecurity were integrated into a concept map.

dct_title_s: Food insecurity among Inuit women in Igloolik, Nunavut: the role of climate change and multiple stressors
